name: Ambient Occlusion
notes: Baked by the exporter with Cycles into a texture on the UV map (needs a UV map); the scene's other visible objects occlude it. Or leave it out and use the scene's SSAO

name: Attribute
notes: Geometry type: color attributes, UV maps and "_" custom attributes (glTF Attributes option). Instancer/Object/View Layer types not supported

name: Bevel
notes: Baked by the exporter with Cycles into a texture on the UV map (needs a UV map). The baked Normal is in world space

name: Color
notes: Named "RGB" in 4.2

name: Color Attribute
notes: By name or render-active, via the exporter's COLOR_n layout; ambiguous when the standard material also uses a color attribute and the mesh has several

name: Curves Info
notes: Out of scope for mesh materials

name: Fresnel
notes: Front faces

name: Geometry
notes: Position, Normal, Tangent, True Normal, Incoming, Backfacing. Not yet (0): Parametric, Random Per Island (exported as an attribute), Pointiness (🧊 baked to a vertex attribute)

name: Layer Weight
notes: Front faces

name: Light Path
notes: Seen by a camera ray, as everything a rasterizer shades: Is Camera Ray 1, the other ray types and depths 0 (parity-tested). Ray Length is the camera ray's length from the near clip plane, as in Cycles (parity-tested, both cameras). Effects that depend on other ray types (hiding from shadows or reflections) do not apply

name: Object Info
notes: Random matches Cycles for non-instanced objects (name hash)

name: Particle Info
notes: Out of scope for mesh materials

name: Point Info
notes: Out of scope for mesh materials

name: Tangent
notes: Radial X/Y/Z. Not yet: UV Map tangents (rendered as Radial Z)

name: Texture Coordinate
notes: All outputs pass parity (ortho and perspective). Not supported yet: the Object setting (another object's space) and From Instancer

name: UV Map
notes: Resolves names via the exported UV map list; From Instancer not supported

name: Volume Info
notes: Volumes

name: Wireframe
notes: World size parity-tested (wire coverage matches; hard edges are anti-aliased differently). Pixel Size follows Cycles but is not parity-tested. Meshes that use it are de-indexed on load to get per-triangle barycentrics

name: Add Shader
notes: Emission and Transparent add exactly (parity-tested for emission); emission added to a BSDF becomes its emission; two BSDFs are summed by their parameters (approximation)

name: Background
notes: Shown as the scene background with applyBlenderWorld(scene, gltf). The world does not light the scene yet (set scene.environment yourself)

name: Diffuse BSDF
notes: Physical material without specular (color parity-tested). Oren-Nayar roughness not mapped

name: Glass BSDF
notes: three.js physical transmission with IOR, roughness, Color tint and thin film (screen-space transmission; close, not identical to Cycles)

name: Glossy BSDF
notes: Fully metallic physical material with the same roughness, Normal and anisotropy (needs mesh tangents; the Tangent input is ignored). No parity test (lighting differs)

name: Hair BSDF
notes: Likely ❌

name: Holdout
notes: Alpha handling, scene-dependent

name: Metallic BSDF
notes: Metal with Base Color reflectance, roughness, anisotropy and thin film. Not mapped: Edge Tint, Physical Conductor (IOR, Extinction)

name: Mix Shader
notes: Emission and Transparent mix exactly (parity-tested for emission). BSDFs are mixed by their parameters: exact for Principled pairs differing in colors, approximate otherwise. Transparency uses straight alpha blending, exact only when blending in linear space

name: Principled BSDF
notes: Base color, metallic, roughness, alpha, emission (base color parity-tested), Normal, and three.js physical equivalents of coat, sheen, transmission, IOR, specular level and tint, thin film and anisotropy (close, not identical to Cycles; see examples/materials). Not mapped: subsurface, coat IOR and tint

name: Principled Hair BSDF
notes: Likely ❌

name: Principled Volume
notes: Volumes

name: Ray Portal BSDF
notes: Path-tracing only

name: Refraction BSDF
notes: Physical transmission without the specular reflection (close, not identical to Cycles)

name: Sheen BSDF
notes: three.js physical sheen (Charlie) over a black, non-specular base: Color, Roughness, Normal. Ashikhmin is rendered as Charlie. Lighting differs from Cycles, so no parity test

name: Specular BSDF
notes: EEVEE-only (Cycles renders it black): mapped like EEVEE onto the physical material (base color, specular color, roughness, emission, transparency, clear coat)

name: Subsurface Scattering
notes: Thickness/translucency fake

name: Toon BSDF
notes: Custom lighting

name: Translucent BSDF
notes: Fake

name: Transparent BSDF
notes: Opacity for Mix/Add Shader (straight alpha blending, exact only when blending in linear space). A tinted Color is rendered untinted

name: Volume Absorption
notes: Volumes

name: Volume Coefficients
notes: Volumes. Blender 5.x

name: Volume Scatter
notes: Volumes

name: Checker Texture
notes: Texture Mapping sidebar settings not supported

name: Environment Texture
notes: Equirectangular and Mirror Ball. Float (HDR) images are embedded as RGBE PNGs (about 1% precision, no alpha)

name: Gabor Texture
notes: 2D and 3D, all outputs. Blender 4.3+. Expensive (72 kernels per pixel in 2D, 216 in 3D): consider baking on phones

name: Gradient Texture
notes: Texture Mapping sidebar settings not supported

name: IES Texture
notes: Belongs to lights

name: Image Texture
notes: Flat/Box/Sphere/Tube, Linear/Closest, all extensions, Cycles' alpha association, 8-bit and float images (float as RGBE: about 1% precision, no alpha). Not yet: Cubic/Smart (rendered Linear), mipmaps

name: Noise Texture
notes: All types (fBm, multifractal, ridged, hybrid, hetero terrain), 1D–4D, distortion, normalize. Musgrave nodes from older files are converted to Noise by Blender

name: Point Density
notes: Blender 4.2 only (removed in 5.x). Baked by the exporter like Ambient Occlusion

name: Sky Texture
notes: Every model of Blender 4.2 and 5.x, baked by the exporter with Cycles to a 1024×512 equirectangular RGBE image (the sky models run in Blender's C++ code). Sharp features such as the sun disc and the multiple-scattering horizon are blurred to the bake's resolution; sky settings cannot change live

name: Voronoi Texture
notes: Every feature and distance metric, 1D–4D, fractal Detail, Normalize. Files from Blender 4.x use 4.x's cell hashing, which gives a different pattern

name: White Noise Texture
notes: Bit-exact Cycles hash. Since the hash depends on the exact float bits of its input, Blender and the browser only agree where the input is computed identically (e.g. snapped coordinates)

name: Mix
notes: Float, Vector (uniform and non-uniform), Color with all blend modes; clamp factor/result

name: Mix (Legacy)
notes: `MixRGB`; same blend code as Mix

name: RGB Curves
notes: Cycles table incl. extrapolation

name: Bump
notes: Cycles' formula on screen-space derivatives of the height (parity-tested). The Filter Width input has no effect

name: Displacement
notes: Object and World space (parity-tested). Material Settings > Displacement: Bump Only (the default) shades with the displaced surface's normal; Displacement moves the vertices (needs a dense mesh; normals are not recomputed); Displacement and Bump is treated as Displacement

name: Mapping
notes: Point, Texture, Vector, Normal

name: Normal Map
notes: Every space and Strength (parity-tested). Tangent space builds its frame from screen-space derivatives of the UV map instead of MikkTSpace tangents: exact on flat, uniformly mapped surfaces, close on curved ones

name: Radial Tiling
notes: New in Blender 5. Deferred to phase 10: a large port (≈900 lines of Blender's GLSL)

name: Vector Curves
notes: Cycles table incl. extrapolation

name: Vector Displacement
notes: Object and World space (parity-tested), as Displacement. Not yet: Tangent space (treated as Object)

name: Blackbody
notes: Interpolates a table measured from Cycles (tools/measure_spectra.py); same in Blender 4.2 and 5.2

name: Clamp
notes: Min Max and Range

name: Color Ramp
notes: Every interpolation and color mode; 257-entry table like Cycles

name: Combine Color
notes: RGB, HSV, HSL

name: Combine HSV / Combine RGB
notes: Legacy, Blender 4.2 only; same code as Combine Color

name: Float Curve
notes: Cycles table incl. extrapolation

name: Map Range
notes: All interpolation types, float and vector

name: Math
notes: All operations and Clamp; Cycles semantics (safe divide, pow, modulo …)

name: Script
notes: OSL not possible in realtime

name: Separate Color
notes: RGB, HSV, HSL

name: Separate HSV / Separate RGB
notes: Legacy, Blender 4.2 only; same code as Separate Color

name: Shader to RGB
notes: Needs custom lighting inside the material

name: Squeeze Value (Legacy)
notes: EEVEE formula. Cycles doesn't implement this node, so there is no parity test

name: Vector Math
notes: All operations (Power, Sign, Round need Blender 4.3+/5.x); Cycles semantics

name: Wavelength
notes: Interpolates a table measured from Cycles (tools/measure_spectra.py), including Cycles' extension down to 375 nm

name: Light Falloff
notes: Belongs to lights

name: Line Style Output
notes: Freestyle only

name: Material Output
notes: Surface and Displacement (see Displacement). Volume is not supported

name: Raycast
notes: Blender 5.x. Needs scene ray tracing

name: UV Along Stroke
notes: Freestyle only

name: World Output
notes: Surface only (no Volume). See Background

name: Frame
notes: Removed by exporter

name: Group / Group Input / Group Output
notes: Flattened by exporter

name: Reroute
notes: Removed by exporter
